title: Beautiful Bird Print!
text: Beautiful Bird Print!. My daughter is renting a house without a dishwasher. She has a drying rack, but it doesn't keep water getting on the counter. With this mat, the counter stays dry. It's very absorbent. She loves the beautiful bird print. It's something she didn't realized that she needed, but is very glad she now has it!
